item.title: RSS updates are now available for UJF Open Calls
item.description:
You can now subscribe to UJF Open Calls in your RSS reader.

  • Future announcements will summarize newly added calls, important deadline or eligibility changes, and significant corrections.
  • Each announcement will link to the Open Calls overview for current details and official sources.

View the current Open Calls overview.
